description:
Experience :  We are hiring talented engineers at all the experience levels
 Employment Type : Full-Time 

 



 Build the Infrastructure of the AI Era: 

 With the AI infrastructure market eclipsing $200B and networking representing 20% to 30% of data center investment, traditional architectures are hitting fundamental scaling boundaries. Backed by $610M+ from Lightspeed Venture Partners and Andreessen Horowitz, Nexthop AI is positioned at the epicenter of this shift. As a Software Engineer, you will build next-generation ultra-low-latency network stacks and high-availability distributed systems powering global AI data centers. Working at the critical convergence of low-level systems software, open-source networking, and hardware-software co-design, you will take end-to-end ownership of mission-critical platform components and shape the core technology driving the AI revolution. 

 



 What you’ll build, own and achieve : 

 
 Architect and ship production-grade software across core networking and distributed systems using C, C++, Python, and open-source stacks like SONiC. 

 Drive hardware-software co-design to optimize packet processing, congestion control, and ASIC memory management for massive AI workloads. 

 Own platforms and  features across their full lifecycle from initial architectural trade-offs, bring ups to deployment and high-availability operational support in global AI data centers. 

 Design ultra-low-latency telemetry, monitoring pipelines and automated fault recovery systems to ensure resilience across multi-tenant fabric environments. 

 Translate ambiguous customer requirements into scalable technical designs, actionable implementation plans, and clear performance metrics. 

 Build specialized automation and CI pipelines tailored for low-level systems, accelerating test, debug, and release cycles. 

 Partner directly with customers and internal hardware/product teams during trials, production bring-up, and technical escalations.  

 
 



 Required Skills : 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

 Strong programming ability in one or more of C, C++, and Python. 

 Solid understanding of systems software, distributed systems, operating systems, or embedded systems. 

 Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to break down complex technical problems. 

 A track record of taking ownership from asking the right questions through implementation, validation, and follow-through. 

 Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and engineers are expected to contribute beyond a narrowly defined box.
